title: Soul Snack #75: It’s Always Yours to Do
excerpt: Explore your full potential, so you can give the gifts you were born to give.
bodyHtml:
Explore your full potential, so you can give the gifts you were born to give. Enroll in Soul Themes Today. Your soul has been waiting for you to take this journey.

In this powerful Soul Snack, Gary Zukav delivers one of the most liberating truths of the multisensory path: everything you are learning, everything you are working toward, and everything you are becoming is entirely yours to do. 

The journey toward Authentic Power cannot be delegated or outsourced – not to a partner, a parent, or a teacher. It belongs to you alone.

Your incarnation is wholly your own. You are responsible for what you have created in it – and you create everything in it. When you recognize this, you reclaim the creative authority that fear-based thinking quietly steals from you every day.

The solution is both simple and transformative: while you cannot determine what your future holds, you can choose how you respond when emotions arise. That Responsible Choice is where Authentic Power is built.

What You’ll Discover in this Soul Snack:

  • (00:02) — The Birth of a New World: Gary opens with the sweeping context of humanity’s unprecedented shift in consciousness and the choice now before every individual: to live in gratitude, patience, contentment, and awe – or in anger, worry, overwhelm, and despair.
  • (00:43) — It’s Always Yours To Do: Gary introduces the central teaching of this session – that everything explored on this path belongs entirely to you. Not your partner, not your parents, not your peers or psychologists. The work, the growth, and the transformation are all yours.
  • (01:00) — Your Incarnation Is Your Responsibility: Understanding that you are fully responsible for what you have created in your incarnation – and that this responsibility is not a weight, but a declaration of your power as a creative, spiritual being.
  • (01:12) — You Create Everything in It: Gary clarifies what it means to be the creator of your experience – not in the sense of controlling outcomes, but in the sense of choosing how you meet every emotion that arises within you.
  • (01:22) — The Power of Conscious Choice: Discovering that while no one can determine the future, every person has the capacity to choose what they will do when they experience their emotions – and that this choice is the foundation of Authentic Power.
